verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical and share the same serious flaws. The purple circle is cut off by a hard vertical edge at about x=500 instead of running off the canvas, so it reads as a broken shape and leaves a strip of wood floor on the right. The robot is cropped and pushed off the top-left, so it no longer reads as the product. The bottom-right dot cluster spills off the circle onto the photo. The text block is readable but sits off-axis from the frame, and the composition feels like the original was stretched sideways rather than rearranged. B's outline frame is slightly better inset: it starts about 38px from the top instead of 22px in A and ends more evenly above the bottom edge. That gives B marginally better margins, but the difference is tiny.
